author: bardic-inspiration
name: Vial of Bottled Dusk
summary: A vial that wraps you in shadow and dims light around you for ten minutes.
description: The glass is cold and always a little darker than it should be. Spies buy it by the dozen.

stats.effect: When you drink this potion, for 10 minutes you shed no light, and Dim Light within 20 feet of you becomes darkness. You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while in Dim Light or darkness.
